modernAdditionsNotSourceFacts: P and Q label the secondary axis in the scan, not independently marked source points. Hollow finite endpoint anchors on modern PQ are presentation/model additions; this review does not claim those circles existed in the source or depict physical light sources.
Other hollow markers regularize the source's named intersections. Only S is drawn with the distinct physical source mark.
Exact focal length 1 and source distance 0.55 are thin-lens normalization, not measured scan values.
The scan's tiny dashed overshoot beyond S1 is omitted without changing the backward intersection or real/virtual distinction.
Secondary-axis direction styling is a construction cue. The physical second light path in current n76 prose is the principal-axis ray, not PQ.
